message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling (both under her own name and her pseudonym Robert Galbraith):

| Title | Publication Year | Notes |
|-------|------------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduced the world‑conquering wizarding saga. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Second installment; deepens the lore of Hogwarts and its mysteries. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Explores the rise of the Ministry’s opposition to the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Provides backstory on Voldemort’s rise and the concept of Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the epic saga with the final battle against Voldemort. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel published under her own name; a dark political drama set in a small town. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable released as a free online book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut of the detective series featuring private investigator Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third installment in the Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike saga. |
| **The Ink Black** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2022 | Fifth entry in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles represent the core of Rowling’s most widely read and commercially successful works. The Harry Potter series remains the cornerstone of her legacy, while her adult novels and the Cormoran Strike detective series have garnered significant critical and fan acclaim.
